description: Structural repairs to the roof of the potting shed.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Potting Shed Location Plan, Potting Shed Block Plan, Potting Shed Site Plan, Design and Access Statement dated October 2019, Heritage Statement dated October 2019, Sheet 02, and unnumbered photograph received: 14/10/2019.
Sheets 01, 03, 04 Rev A and 05 received: 07/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All works of making good shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
